body:
Devon: Short postmortem follow-up - owners, quick milestones, and measurable acceptance for streaming/chat fixes (timeouts, partial chunks, reconnects).
Anya: Keep it brief: owner + 10-day window + one clear metric each.
Devon: Agreed. Three workstreams: reconnection/backoff hygiene, detect+resume partials, and telemetry + canary safety.
Matt: I'll own reconnect/backoff. Plan: small client library (jittered exponential), server handshake flag to decline stale resumes, staging validation, then canary.
Lia: I'll own partial-response detection and safe-resume. Building a harness that replays production chunk sequences and force-closes sockets to validate idempotency.
incident-bot: created INC-2401 "streaming resiliency remediation" https://tracker/redwood/INC-2401
Matt: timeline (compact):
- day 0-2: client lib + server flag
- day 3-5: staging runs (success/latency matrix)
- day 6: 10% canary
- day 7-10: ramp to 100% if green
Anya: proposed acceptance criteria: reconnect success >= 99.5% within 30s; partial-response rate reduced >= 90%; token-rate latency regression <= 5%.
Lia: add metrics we must emit: resume_attempts, resume_success_rate, duplicate_resume_count. Resume flow must be safe to retry.
Devon: SRE to attach canary runbook and rollback triggers. Auto-rollback if streaming error rate >0.5% for 5m or token-latency >2x baseline for 3m.
SRE-Bot: canary runbook attached to INC-2401; rollback criteria configured.
Anya: observability tasks: alert when partial_chunk_rate >0.1% over 5m; dashboard per-route resume latency; sample traces of failed resumes to inspect KV cache state.
Devon: recurring pattern note: spikes around 03:00 UTC on low-load pools; hypothesis: kube node TCP keepalive + client keepalive mismatch. Infra to test aggressive keepalive on canary pool.
Matt: backoff pseudo (to be upstreamed):
```
function backoffMs(attempt) {
  return Math.min(10000, 200 * Math.pow(2, attempt) + Math.random()*150);
}
await sleep(backoffMs(attempt));
```
Lia: harness ETA 5 days; will attach repro steps and logs to INC-2401.
Matt: PR target day 4, will ping @Anya + @Devon for review.
Anya: I'll own QA sign-off and coordinate synthetic job that opens streams + force-closes sockets every 10s for regression detection.
Devon: owners & compact due dates: Matt (reconnect/backoff + canary) due 2026-04-06; Lia (partial-detection harness + resume) due 2026-04-04; Anya (telemetry + QA canary checklist) due 2026-04-08; SRE (canary runbook + rollback) done.
Devon: cadence - weekly 30m sync Mondays starting 2026-03-30. Post short updates here: "ok/blocker/done".
Anya: ack - will post staging numbers Monday.
Matt: ack - will drop PR link here.
Lia: ack - starting harness now.
Devon: If blocked, tag #eng-oncall and drop a one-line status here.
SRE-Bot: weekly follow-up meeting scheduled Mon 09:00 UTC."
